scope: C04 supplementary reference: compact place structure, sightlines and traversal
method: The supplementary reference was evaluated only for C04 compact-place structure. Independent professional criticism, release-period player discussion and later player discussion were separated. Contrary evidence was retained. No combat, narrative or whole-product quality was transferred into this selection.

result.selection: four axes substantiated for the supplementary reference
positiveBasis: Independent criticism identifies knotted separate zones, off-critical-path secrets, grapple-connected trees and rooftops, and multiple simultaneous exploration avenues.
Release-period player discussion identifies visitable distant landmarks, branching routes, shortcuts and multiple approaches.
Later player discussion still specifically evaluates traversal across named areas, sightline-connected landmarks, verticality and interconnection.
counterevidence: The professional review describes the first ten hours as visually bland and samey before later variety opens.
Player discussion says some later areas become linear or uninteresting.
Later discussion includes disagreement about environment quality and reports of getting lost.
result.fitBoundary: Use only as a supplement for one compact shrine/path/sightline/vertical-traversal place. Do not substitute it for C04 primary GT or transfer whole-world scale, combat or story quality.
remaining: Acquire actual matched same-purpose traversal media and perform a valid source-blind comparison.
Complete the remaining incomplete four-axis selections for other elements.

formalVerdictReason: No candidate/reference source-blind comparison was performed. Reference-selection research cannot assign a game-element verdict.

verification.result: PASS: 10 units, 16 legacy groups, 62 legacy criteria, six negative checks, fixed instruction text unchanged
